rows.market_wrap: Nifty fell 0.63% to 25,228 and the Sensex lost about 500 points, with metals, IT and FMCG the weakest sectors and mid caps down nearly 1%; a dollar near a 19-month high and rising bets on a US Fed rate rise in December weighed on sentiment even as crude eased. Your stocks and ETFs fell 1.5%, mostly because silver and gold slid again; today's mutual-fund NAVs were not yet published by 10:07 PM IST, so fund values still reflect 17 November.
